question: Should authenticated identity binding remain exclusively under `import hydrate-profiles`, or should `init --account` become a second permanent command surface with fresh-database-only semantics?
rationale: Both implementations can work technically, but the choice defines lasting CLI, provider-routing, and upgrade contracts that tests cannot settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend hydration command
options.body: Move exact OAuth2 selection to `import hydrate-profiles --account <username>` with an account-only mode and one identity-binding workflow.

options.title: Keep init selection
options.body: Retain `init --account` only after explicitly approving the parallel command surface and documenting and testing pre-marker database behavior.

options.title: Pause pending CLI direction
options.body: Leave the PR open unchanged until the permanent command and upgrade policy are selected.

recommendation.title: Extend hydration command
recommendation.body: Move exact OAuth2 selection to `import hydrate-profiles --account <username>` with an account-only mode and one identity-binding workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and the strongest product-boundary signal, this person is best positioned to choose the permanent CLI contract.
